schemes.target_category: Meritorious College / University Undergraduates (General, EWS, OBC, SC, ST)
schemes.eligibility: Must be a permanent resident of Rajasthan. Passed Class 12 board examination (RBSE or recognized) with minimum 60% marks and ranked within the first 1,00,000 students in the board merit. Annual family income from all sources must not exceed INR 2,50,000 (2.5 Lakhs). Must be enrolled in a regular higher education course.
schemes.benefit: INR 500 per month (total INR 5,000 per academic year for 10 months) for regular degree courses up to 5 years (UG and PG). Specially-abled students receive INR 1,000 per month (INR 10,000 per year).
schemes.key_deadlines: Annual application window opens between July and October; renewal applications required annually through SSO portal.
required_documents: College Admission Fee Receipt & Student ID
Active Bank Account Passbook seeded with Jan Aadhaar

schemes.scheme_name: Kalibai Bheel Medhavi Chhatra Scooty Vitran Yojana
schemes.scheme_name_hi: कालीबाई भील मेधावी छात्रा स्कूटी वितरण योजना
schemes.target_category: Meritorious Girl Students (SC, ST, OBC, General/EWS, Minorities)
schemes.eligibility: Female students who are bonafide residents of Rajasthan. Must have secured at least 65% marks in Class 12 from RBSE (Rajasthan Board) or at least 75% marks in CBSE. Must be enrolled in regular undergraduate degree courses in recognized colleges in Rajasthan without educational gap. Annual family income must be under INR 2.5 Lakhs.
schemes.benefit: Free motorized scooty (two-wheeler) equipped with helmet, 2 liters of petrol, five-year third-party insurance, and registration charges covered. For differently-abled girl students, motorized tricycles or an equivalent cash grant of INR 40,000 is offered.
schemes.key_deadlines: Applications invited between August and November annually via Rajasthan SSO Higher Education portal.
required_documents: Valid Driving License / Learner Permit (or undertaking)

schemes.scheme_name: Devnarayan Chhatra Scooty Vitran Evam Protsahan Rashi Yojana
schemes.scheme_name_hi: देवनारायण छात्रा स्कूटी वितरण एवं प्रोत्साहन राशि योजना
schemes.target_category: Meritorious Girl Students belonging to Most Backward Classes (MBC - Gurjar, Raika, Rebari, Banjara, Gadia Luhar, Gadariya)
schemes.eligibility: Girl students of Rajasthan MBC communities. Passed Class 12 board exams with at least 50% marks. Admitted to first year of regular degree program (BA, BSc, BCom, BTech, MBBS, etc.). Family annual income should not exceed INR 2,50,000.
schemes.benefit: Merit-selected candidates receive a free motorized Scooty with accessories and insurance. Alternatively, eligible students who do not receive a scooty receive financial incentive: INR 10,000/year during graduation, and INR 20,000/year during post-graduation (MA, MSc, MCom).
schemes.key_deadlines: Applications active July to October; evaluated strictly by Department of Higher Education Rajasthan.
required_documents: MBC Caste Certificate (Gurjar, Raika, Banjara, etc.)

schemes.scheme_name: Rajasthan Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme (Uttar Matric Chhatravriti)
schemes.scheme_name_hi: राजस्थान उत्तर मैट्रिक छात्रवृत्ति योजना (सामाजिक न्याय एवं अधिकारिता विभाग)
schemes.target_category: Post-secondary students belonging to SC, ST, SBC, OBC, EWS, and Specially Abled categories
schemes.eligibility: Permanent resident of Rajasthan studying in Class 11, 12, ITI, Polytechnic, Diploma, UG, PG, or Professional courses (Engineering, Medical, Law) in recognized institutions. Annual family income limits: SC/ST up to INR 2.5 Lakhs; OBC/EWS up to INR 1.5 Lakhs (with specific deprivation criteria like BPL, Antyodaya, or single mother).
schemes.benefit: Complete 100% reimbursement of non-refundable tuition and institutional fees, plus a monthly maintenance allowance ranging from INR 550 to INR 1,200 per month depending on whether the student is a hosteller or day-scholar.
schemes.key_deadlines: Portal opens annually from August to December; institute verification by January.
required_documents: Income Certificate in prescribed Government Format

schemes.target_category: Aspirants from SC, ST, OBC, MBC, EWS, Minorities, and Specially Abled Categories preparing for competitive exams
schemes.eligibility: Domiciled in Rajasthan. Family annual income less than INR 8,00,000 (8 Lakhs) or candidate's parent working in Rajasthan Govt in Pay Matrix Level-11. Minimum qualifying marks: 60% in 12th/Graduation (varies by targeted exam). Targeted exams include UPSC Civil Services, RPSC RAS, REET, NEET, IIT-JEE, CLAT, CA-FC, CS, and Banking/SSC exams.
schemes.benefit: 100% free coaching at top empanelled coaching institutes across Jaipur, Kota, Jodhpur, and other major hubs. Additionally, an annual accommodation & lodging allowance of INR 40,000 is directly transferred to candidates preparing outside their home district.
schemes.key_deadlines: Two rounds per fiscal year: Phase 1 in June–July and Phase 2 in August–September.
required_documents: Proof of admission in empanelled coaching institute

schemes.scheme_name: Rajasthan Free Tablet Yojana (School Shiksha Vibhag)
schemes.scheme_name_hi: राजस्थान मुफ्त टैबलेट योजना (स्कूल शिक्षा विभाग)
schemes.target_category: Meritorious School Students of Class 8, 10, and 12 Board Examinations
schemes.eligibility: Students studying in Rajasthan Government or RBSE affiliated schools who secured top merit ranks in the Class 8, Class 10, and Class 12 board examinations across the state.
schemes.benefit: Complimentary high-performance 4G/5G smart tablet pre-loaded with digital syllabus and e-learning resources, along with 3 years of free high-speed internet data connectivity via SIM card.
schemes.key_deadlines: No separate application form needed by students; merit lists are verified and tablets delivered directly via school principals and District Education Officers (DEO).
required_documents: RBSE Board Examination Roll Number & Marksheet
Jan Aadhaar Card for identity verification

schemes.scheme_name: Vidhwa / Parityakta Mukhyamantri Sambal Yojana (Higher Education)
schemes.scheme_name_hi: विधवा एवं परित्यक्ता मुख्यमंत्री उच्च शिक्षा संबल योजना
schemes.target_category: Widowed, abandoned, or divorced female students pursuing higher education in Rajasthan
schemes.eligibility: Permanent female resident of Rajasthan who is a widow, legally divorced, or officially abandoned, enrolled in regular undergraduate or postgraduate degree courses in government or aided colleges.
schemes.benefit: Complete refund of all college tuition and laboratory fees, along with an annual maintenance stipend of INR 5,000 to INR 10,000 to enable uninterrupted completion of higher education and employment readiness.
schemes.key_deadlines: Rolling application cycle through the academic year on the HTE scholarship portal.
required_documents: Death certificate of spouse (for widow) or legal divorce decree / abandonment certificate
Jan Aadhaar Card & Rajasthan Domicile Certificate
